headline.title: Angine de Poitrine at Brooklyn Steel tonight
headline.body: Doors at 7, show at 8 at the East Williamsburg room, a short L ride from Greenpoint. Check the venue page for tickets before you go.
headline.meta: Brooklyn Steel, East Williamsburg · tickets via venue

picks.title: Angine de Poitrine at Brooklyn Steel
picks.body: The band plays the East Williamsburg room tonight. Doors at 7 PM, show at 8. Check the Bowery Presents page for ticket availability.

picks.title: Guster at Music Hall of Williamsburg
picks.body: The band is listed for back-to-back nights at the Williamsburg venue. Confirm which night has tickets left.

picks.title: Resavoir at Baby's All Right
picks.body: The Austin jazz-leaning collective plays the Williamsburg room on Saturday. Tickets listed from $20.

picks.title: NYC Winter Lantern Festival opens in Queens
picks.body: Lantern displays light up Queens County Farm in Glen Oaks, 5 to 10 PM, starting Thursday. End date is listed as Jan 3.

picks.title: The Photography Triennial: After Dark opens
picks.body: The Museum of the City of New York looks at the city's nightlife through contemporary photography, opening to the public Friday.
picks.meta: Museum of the City of New York · admission
picks.place: Museum of the City of New York, East Harlem

picks.title: Historic New York: a Greenpoint history walk
picks.body: NYC Parks rangers lead a walk on the neighborhood's industrial past and immigrant communities, ending at WNYC Transmitter Park.

picks.title: Greenpoint-McCarren Park Greenmarket
picks.body: The Saturday farmers market sets up on Union Avenue between Driggs and N 12th Street.

picks.title: Holiday Shops at Bryant Park Winter Village
picks.body: Urbanspace's 180-plus vendor market runs daily beside the free-entry rink. Good for gifts and hot cider after work.

picks.title: Paper Tiger opens at Nitehawk Williamsburg
picks.body: The film opens Friday at Nitehawk, which also lists midnight screenings on Friday and Saturday nights.

picks.title: Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses
picks.body: The Brooklyn Museum's fashion exhibition on the Dutch designer's sculptural work stays up through Dec 6.

facts.t: The USS Monitor was assembled in about 101 days at Greenpoint's Continental Iron Works, near Franklin Street and N 15th Street, not at the Brooklyn Navy Yard.

countdowns.title: Lightscape opens
countdowns.body: Brooklyn Botanic Garden's winter light trail runs Nov 20 to Jan 3.

countdowns.title: 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
countdowns.body: Thursday, 8:30 AM to noon, from 77th Street to Herald Square. Free on the sidewalk.

countdowns.title: Rockefeller Center tree lighting
countdowns.body: The 2026 ceremony is Wednesday, Dec 2. Free, first come, first served.
